title: Es que fíjese
desc: A job that is not ready, and the man who talks first
setting: You come back on Friday at four for welding that was promised for Friday at four.

steps.speaker: Dueño
steps.es: Es que fíjese, don, que se me enfermó el hijo.
steps.en: The thing is, sir, my son fell ill.

options.es: Ay, qué pena. ¿Y ya está mejor el chavalo?
options.en: Oh, I am sorry. And is the boy better now?
options.feedback: You went to the reason before the job. That is what the reason was offered for.
You received it. Asking after the boy is what turns it from an excuse into a relationship.
He is telling you why. Cutting to the work makes the reason worthless and both of you smaller.

steps.speaker: Dueño
steps.es: Ya está mejor, gracias a Dios. Pero no avancé nada.
steps.en: He is better now, thank God. But I made no progress.

options.es: Se entiende. ¿Para cuándo me lo puede tener?
options.en: That is understandable. When can you have it for me?
options.feedback: Accepted, then asked for the new date. That date is the real commitment and it is yours to ask for.
Generous, and it walks out without a date. Now it is nobody's job.
True. It also puts a sick child and your bracket on the same scale.

steps.speaker: Dueño
steps.es: El lunes sin falta. A las cuatro.

options.es: El lunes a las cuatro. Aquí estoy.
options.en: Monday at four. I will be here.
options.feedback: Repeated back, so it exists. That is how a new date stops being another maybe.
Accepted. Without the hour it can become Monday evening.
One line, and the whole thing you both just did carefully is undone.

steps.speaker: Dueño
steps.es: Y disculpe la molestia, de verdad.
steps.en: And I am sorry for the trouble, honestly.

options.es: No se preocupe. A cualquiera le pasa.
options.en: Do not worry about it. It happens to anybody.
options.feedback: Given back cleanly. He will remember that you did not make him pay for it twice.
Accepted. Slightly flat for a man who apologised properly.

options.es: Sí, es que me atrasó bastante.
options.en: Yes, it did set me back quite a bit.
options.feedback: He apologised and you invoiced him for it.
